rationale: Python-rsa exposes real contracts from arithmetic and codecs to key generation, from key models to DER/PEM serialization, and from codec/key behavior to PKCS#1 operations. The modules and public tests form natural ownership boundaries despite the compact task size. The crypto API metric currently lists key.py under the arithmetic producer, so that composite dependency must be split or represented with multiple producers before strict CAIL attribution.
